settings.heading:
Keep something meaningful
looking beautiful.
settings.text: A few simple habits will keep your pendant’s polished finish looking its best.

settings.title: Cleaning
settings.text: Wipe the pendant and chain gently with a soft, dry jewellery or microfibre cloth. For a deeper clean, use a little mild soap in lukewarm water, rinse, and dry straight away.

settings.title: Drying
settings.text: Pat the necklace completely dry after it gets wet, paying attention to the chain links and clasp, before you store it.

settings.title: Storage
settings.text: Store it on its own, in a soft pouch or lined box, with the clasp fastened so the chain doesn’t tangle.

settings.title: Avoiding scratches
settings.text: A mirror polish will show fine marks over time. Keep it away from harder jewellery, keys and rough surfaces, and take it off for the gym and gardening.

settings.title: The polished surface
settings.text: Use only a soft cloth on the mirror face. Avoid abrasive pads, toothpaste or polishing compounds, which can dull the finish and soften engraved detail.

settings.title: What to avoid
settings.text: Put perfume, lotion and hairspray on before your necklace. Remove it before swimming in chlorinated pools or the sea, and keep it away from bleach and household cleaning chemicals.

settings.heading: Last on, first off.
settings.text:
Put your necklace on after perfume, lotion and hairspray, and take it off before swimming, showering, exercise and cleaning.

This is general guidance for polished stainless steel jewellery. If the instructions supplied with your necklace differ, follow those.
